theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ f v → analyticOrderAt f v ≠ ⊤ → ∃ (r M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧ AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (Metric.closedBall v r) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall v r, ‖G z‖ ≤ M) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball v r, z ≠ v → f z ≠ 0 ∧ deriv f z / f z = (analyticOrderNatAt f v : ℂ) / (z - v) + G z
